title: SPLASH: Contrastive Audit Pressure for Detecting and Localizing Security Hallucinations in Generated Code
title_zh: SPLASH：用于检测和定位生成代码中安全幻觉的对比式审计压力方法

paragraphs.en: 总结：SPLASH通过对比安全审计与风格审查的审计压力，无需训练即可检测并定位大模型生成代码中的安全幻觉。 Code generated by large language models often passes every functional test while remaining insecure. These security hallucinations are common, written with high confidence, and repeated across samples, so neither the generator's own uncertainty nor static analyzers reliably catch them. We introduce SPLASH, which is guided by a new measure called audit pressure. It contrasts teacher-forced log-probabilities for the generated program under a security review and a style review. Aggregated to statements and programs, and grounded in a probabilistic model of competing edits, audit pressure allows SPLASH to choose the secure program among a model's candidate programs and locate the vulnerable statement, with no model training, CWE-specific rules, or internal access to the generating model. On 63,684 programs generated by 12 models for 899 tasks, SPLASH picks secure code in 74% of cases, places the vulnerable statement first in 58% of insecure programs, and chooses better than a frontier LLM judge.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：SPLASH通过对比安全审计与风格审查的审计压力，无需训练即可检测并定位大模型生成代码中的安全幻觉。由大语言模型生成的代码往往能通过所有功能性测试，却仍不安全。 这些安全幻觉很常见，以高置信度写出，并在不同样本中重复出现，因此无论是生成模型自身的不确定性还是静态分析器，都无法可靠地捕捉它们。 我们提出SPLASH，它由一种称为审计压力的新度量所引导。 它在安全审查和风格审查两种条件下，对比生成程序在教师强制下的对数概率。 审计压力被聚合到语句和程序层面，并建立在竞争性编辑的概率模型基础上，使SPLASH能够在模型的候选程序中选出安全程序并定位易受攻击的语句，且无需模型训练、无需CWE特定规则、也无需生成模型的内部访问权限。 在12个模型为899个任务生成的63,684个程序上，SPLASH在74%的案例中选出了安全代码，在58%的不安全程序中将易受攻击语句排在首位，并且优于前沿大语言模型评判者。
